hero.label: Made for Tractian
hero.headline: I want to help Tractian bring Physical AI to every factory floor.
hero.subheadline: Tractian is doing something rare: turning industrial sensors into a platform that actually changes how maintenance teams operate. The combination of hardware, AI, and a NRR that rivals Snowflake tells me this product sells itself once the right people see it. I want to be the person getting it in front of them.

whyCompany.title: Physical AI for industrial ops is a category still being defined
whyCompany.body: Predictive maintenance is moving from a niche engineering concern to a boardroom priority as manufacturers face pressure to cut unplanned downtime. Tractian sits at the intersection of IoT hardware, machine learning, and CMMS software in a way that competitors have not matched. That kind of full-stack differentiation makes prospecting conversations genuinely interesting, not just transactional.

whyCompany.title: Y Combinator-backed, scaling fast, SDR seat still open
whyCompany.body: Tractian has the NRR of a late-stage SaaS company but is still actively building out its outbound motion, which means reps who join now have real upside as the territory and playbook take shape. Igor Marinelli is a Berkeley engineering founder who thinks in systems, and that DNA usually produces a sales culture that rewards curiosity over script-reading. Getting in at this moment, not after the next funding round, is the opportunity.

whyCompany.title: My BDR track record maps directly onto what Tractian needs
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I built cold outreach sequences in HubSpot and on LinkedIn that contributed to acquiring 15 to 20 paying clients from scratch, which is exactly the prospecting motion Tractian describes for this role. At NextAfter I learned how to research decision-maker psychology and tailor messaging to specific buyer pain points in a B2B context. Reaching maintenance managers and plant operations leads is a new vertical for me, but the outbound muscle is already there.

quote: I have spent the last year proving I can open doors in markets where nobody has heard of the product yet. Tractian has a product that practically sells itself once a maintenance manager sees it in action, and I want to be the person making that introduction happen at scale.
